documentation.title: Separated start: a body supported only through contact, stabilised into contact
documentation.description:
The configuration contact could not previously solve, and the gate on the stabilization attribute.
Two stacked plane-strain blocks whose interface starts 0.05 APART, with the upper body held in y by nothing but the contact interface -- its only other support suppresses the lateral rigid-body mode. A pressure on its top face must therefore close the clearance before any load can be carried at all.
Without stabilisation this does not work. At u = 0 no contact point is active, so there is no stiffness whatsoever in the direction the body must travel: the tangent has an unconstrained rigid-body mode and the Newton step is whatever the linear solver makes of a numerically singular system. Swept over a range of initial clearances, several models failed outright with NON CONVERGENCE and the ones that converged did so only after excursions to enormous residuals, with no pattern in which clearances worked. Converging by luck, not by method.
stabilization="1e-3" puts a small artificial normal stiffness on the paired-but-open points. It removes the singular direction, so the step is bounded and the body walks into contact monotonically; the same sweep then converges almost everywhere with monotone active-set sequences.
It cannot change the answer, and that is the point of how it is built: the stabilisation is assembled as a NEWTON form, so it enters the tangent only and contributes no force. Verified directly on ContactPartialLiftoff3d, where half the points stay open at convergence so the stabilisation really is present in the converged tangent: the displacement field is unchanged to machine precision even at a hundred times the value, while the iteration count climbs.
Once the clearance is closed the answer is the ordinary patch test, which is what makes the assertions independent of the stabilisation itself: totalContactForce = 2e6 applied pressure x interface length, by equilibrium maxPressure = 1e6 the applied pressure, transmitted exactly minGap = -p/eps_N identical to ContactPatchTest2d
